snippet.title: All Hail the Orb Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
So turns out I'm releasing a game in March and for Next Fest February!  It's a short incremental game about Cultists, Ducks and The Orb!

If you enjoy incremental games I'd appreciate testers and wishlists! :)

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4262310/_All_Hail_the_Orb/
Alpha Test - https://legingerdev.itch.io/all-hail-the-orb-alpha

#incremental #idle #indiegame #indiedev #unity #gamedev
